title: Release notes — releasenotes/<version>.yaml (v1)
description: The authored, version-keyed release-notes corpus (P31): one file per shipped a2a version, surfaced via `a2a whatsnew`. Each entry is a directive a2a informs on — the agent decides and runs it (scope: space is never run by a2a itself).

version.description: Dotted major.minor.patch, matching this file's own name (e.g. 0.4.0.yaml -> "0.4.0").

kind.description: What the entry IS. The first five describe something that changed in this version. `known-issue` is different in kind and was added 2026-07-25 for a reason worth stating: an agent reading release notes needs to learn not only what moved but what is currently BROKEN OR INCOMPLETE and therefore which surface to avoid — and there was no way to say that, so it went unsaid. A known-issue entry describes a standing limitation, not a change, and is expected to reappear in later versions until it is fixed (at which point it ships as a `fix`).
